info.name: Frappe JWT Auth API
info.description:
JWT-based authentication for Frappe/ERPNext — works on any client (mobile, web, API).

Token lifecycle:
- POST login        -> access token (15 min) + refresh token (7 days)
- POST refresh      -> rotated access + refresh tokens (old refresh revoked)
- POST logout       -> revoke a refresh token, or all tokens for the Bearer user
- GET  me           -> current user info from the Bearer token

Prerequisites (site-level):
1. site_config.json must contain `encryption_key` or `secret_key` (used as the JWT signing secret).
   bench --site <site> set-config encryption_key "$(openssl rand -base64 32)"
2. Restart bench after installing the app so the editable install is picked up.

Setup:
1. Import this collection.
2. Set collection variables: base_url (default http://frappe-dev.autopilotstore.co.id), usr, pwd.
3. Send Login first — its test script stores access_token / refresh_token as collection variables automatically.
4. Me / Get List use Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}.

Notes:
- Frappe wraps returned dicts under a "message" envelope, e.g. {"message": {...}}.
- Missing required arguments return HTTP 417 (FrappeTypeError).
- An invalid/expired JWT on a protected endpoint returns HTTP 401 (AuthenticationError from Frappe core).

item.name: 1. Login
item.description:
Authenticate with email + password. Returns an access token (15 min) and a refresh token (7 days). The test script stores both tokens as collection variables for the other requests.

Errors: 401 {"message": {"message": "Invalid credentials"}}

exec: const data = (body.message && typeof body.message === 'object' && body.message.access_token) ? body.message : body;

item.name: 2. Refresh

exec: const data = (body.message && typeof body.message === 'object' && body.message.access_token) ? body.message : body;

item.name: 3. Me

exec: const data = body.message && typeof body.message === 'object' ? body.message : body;

item.name: 4. Logout
item.description:
Two modes:
1. Revoke a specific refresh token: send {"refresh_token": "..."} (shown here).
2. Revoke ALL refresh tokens for the Bearer-authenticated user: send the Bearer header and an empty body {}.

Always returns 200 {"message": {"message": "ok"}}.

exec: const data = body.message && typeof body.message === 'object' ? body.message : body;

item.name: 5. Get List (standard endpoint via JWT)
item.description:
Proof that the JWT middleware unlocks ALL standard Frappe endpoints — the same Bearer token works for frappe.client.get_list, frappe.client.get, frappe.client.insert, etc. No api_key/secret, no session cookie.

Run this after Login.
